title: 在餐廳點餐 — Ordering at a Restaurant
context: You are at a restaurant in Taipei and the waiter comes to take your order.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.hanzi: 您好！這是菜單。請問您想吃什麼？
turns.pinyin: nín hǎo! zhè shì càidān. qǐngwèn nín xiǎng chī shénme?
turns.translation: Hello! Here is the menu. What would you like to eat?
turns.zhuyin: ㄋㄧㄣˊ ㄏㄠˇ！ ㄓㄜˋ ㄕˋ ㄘㄞˋ ㄉㄢ。 ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄨㄣˋ ㄋㄧㄣˊ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄔ ㄕㄣˊ ㄇㄜ˙？
turns.text: 您好！這是菜單。請問您想吃什麼？
turns.romanization: nín hǎo! zhè shì càidān. qǐngwèn nín xiǎng chī shénme?
turns.translation_en: Hello! Here is the menu. What would you like to eat?
turns.translation_id: Halo! Ini menu. Mau makan apa?

choices.hanzi: 我想點一碗牛肉麵和一杯珍珠奶茶。
choices.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng diǎn yì wǎn niúròu miàn hé yì bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá.
choices.translation: I'd like to order a bowl of beef noodles and a bubble milk tea.
choices.feedback: Natural order: specify what you want using 想點.
choices.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄧ ㄨㄢˇ ㄋㄧㄡˊ ㄖㄡˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄏㄜˊ ㄧ ㄅㄟ ㄓㄣ ㄓㄨ ㄋㄞˇ ㄔㄚˊ。

choices.feedback: They didn't ask about your nationality.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.hanzi: 好的，牛肉麵和珍珠奶茶。還需要別的嗎？
turns.pinyin: hǎo de, niúròu miàn hé zhēnzhū nǎichá. hái xūyào bié de ma?
turns.translation: Okay, beef noodles and bubble milk tea. Anything else?
turns.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄉㄜ˙， ㄋㄧㄡˊ ㄖㄡˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄏㄜˊ ㄓㄣ ㄓㄨ ㄋㄞˇ ㄔㄚˊ。 ㄏㄞˊ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄇㄚ˙？
turns.text: 好的，牛肉麵和珍珠奶茶。還需要別的嗎？
turns.romanization: hǎo de, niúròu miàn hé zhēnzhū nǎichá. hái xūyào bié de ma?
turns.translation_en: Okay, beef noodles and bubble milk tea. Anything else?
turns.translation_id: Baik, mi sapi dan teh susu mutiara. Ada lagi?

choices.pinyin: búyòng le, zhèyàng jiù hǎo. xièxie!
choices.translation: That's all, no need. Thank you!
choices.feedback: Polite way to confirm the order.
choices.zhuyin: ㄅㄨˋ ㄩㄥˋ ㄌㄜ˙， ㄓㄜˋ ㄧㄤˋ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄏㄠˇ。 ㄒㄧㄝˋ ㄒㄧㄝˋ！

choices.feedback: Too vague: specify what you want.
You just sat down to eat.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.pinyin: qǐng shāo děng, mǎshàng jiù lái.
turns.translation: Please wait a moment, it will be right out.
turns.zhuyin: ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄕㄠ ㄉㄥˇ， ㄇㄚˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄌㄞˊ。
turns.romanization: qǐng shāo děng, mǎshàng jiù lái.
turns.translation_en: Please wait a moment, it will be right out.

context_en: You are at a restaurant in Taipei and the waiter comes to take your order.

title_en: 在餐廳點餐 — Ordering at a Restaurant
title_id: 在餐廳點餐 — Memesan di Restoran

title: 可能
context: You chat about probably, maybe, perhaps.
context_en: You chat about probably, maybe, perhaps.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 文件太大，下載可能需要幾分鐘。
turns.hanzi: 文件太大，下載可能需要幾分鐘。
turns.pinyin: wén jiàn tài dà ， xià zài kě néng xū yào jǐ fēn zhōng 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄨㄣˊ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄊㄞˋ ㄉㄚˋ ， ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄈㄣ ㄓㄨㄥ 。
turns.romanization: Wénjiàn tài dà, xiàzài kěnéng xūyào jǐ fēnzhōng.
turns.translation: The file is too large, so downloading it may take a few minutes.
turns.translation_en: The file is too large, so downloading it may take a few minutes.
turns.translation_id: Mohon jangan sembarangan mengunduh materi dari sumber yang tidak dikenal.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 這種藥物可能會影響睡眠，服用前要看說明。
turns.hanzi: 這種藥物可能會影響睡眠，服用前要看說明。
turns.pinyin: zhè zhǒng yào wù kě néng huì yǐng xiǎng shuì mián ， fú yòng qián yào kàn shuō míng 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄓㄨㄥˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄨˋ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄧㄥˇ ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄕㄨㄟˋ ㄇㄧㄢˊ ， ㄈㄨˊ ㄩㄥˋ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ㄧㄠˋ ㄎㄢˋ ㄕㄨㄛ ㄇㄧㄥˊ 。
turns.romanization: Zhè zhǒng yàowù kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng shuìmián, fúyòng qián yào kàn shuōmíng.
turns.translation: This medication may affect sleep, so read the instructions before taking it.
turns.translation_en: This medication may affect sleep, so read the instructions before taking it.
turns.translation_id: Obat ini mungkin memengaruhi tidur, jadi bacalah petunjuknya sebelum meminumnya.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 不要把不同觀點看作衝突，它們也可能帶來新的思路。
turns.hanzi: 不要把不同觀點看作衝突，它們也可能帶來新的思路。
turns.pinyin: bú yào bǎ bù tóng guān diǎn kàn zuò chōng tū ， tā men yě kě néng dài lái xīn de sī lù 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄅㄨˊ ㄧㄠˋ ㄅㄚˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄍㄨㄢ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄎㄢˋ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄔㄨㄥ ㄊㄨ ， ㄊㄚ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄧㄝˇ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄉㄞˋ ㄌㄞˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄙ ㄌㄨˋ 。
turns.romanization: Bú yào bǎ bùtóng guāndiǎn kànzuò chōngtū, tāmen yě kěnéng dài lái xīn de sīlù.
turns.translation: Do not regard different viewpoints as conflict; they may also bring new ways of thinking.
turns.translation_en: Do not regard different viewpoints as conflict; they may also bring new ways of thinking.
turns.translation_id: Jangan menganggap perbedaan pandangan sebagai konflik; hal itu justru bisa membuka cara berpikir yang baru.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 他臉色明顯不好，可能昨晚沒有休息夠。
turns.hanzi: 他臉色明顯不好，可能昨晚沒有休息夠。
turns.pinyin: tā liǎn sè míng xiǎn bù hǎo ， kě néng zuó wǎn méi yǒu xiū xī gòu 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄌㄧㄢˇ ㄙㄜˋ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄢˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄏㄠˇ ， ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄗㄨㄛˊ ㄨㄢˇ ㄇㄟˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄒㄧㄡ ㄒㄧ ㄍㄡˋ 。
turns.romanization: Tā liǎnsè míngxiǎn bù hǎo, kěnéng zuó wǎn méiyǒu xiūxi gòu.
turns.translation: His complexion is obviously not good; he probably did not get enough rest last night.
turns.translation_en: His complexion is obviously not good; he probably did not get enough rest last night.
turns.translation_id: Kulitnya jelas tidak bagus; dia mungkin tidak cukup istirahat tadi malam.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 不同群體對同一問題可能有不同觀點。
turns.hanzi: 不同群體對同一問題可能有不同觀點。
turns.pinyin: bù tóng qún tǐ duì tóng yī wèn tí kě néng yǒu bù tóng guān diǎn 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄅㄨˋ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄑㄩㄣˊ ㄊㄧˇ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄧ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄋㄥˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄍㄨㄢ ㄉㄧㄢˇ 。
turns.romanization: Bùtóng qúntǐ duì tóng yí wèntí kěnéng yǒu bùtóng guāndiǎn.
turns.translation: Different groups may have different views on the same issue.
turns.translation_en: Different groups may have different views on the same issue.
turns.translation_id: Kelompok yang berbeda mungkin mempunyai pandangan berbeda mengenai isu yang sama.

title: 孩子
title_en: Talking about kids,child, childern / son, daughter
context: You chat about kids,child, childern / son, daughter.
context_en: You chat about kids,child, childern / son, daughter.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 孩子們為了誰先玩玩具爭了起來。
turns.hanzi: 孩子們為了誰先玩玩具爭了起來。
turns.pinyin: hái zi men wèi le shuí xiān wán wán jù zhēng le qǐ lái 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄨㄟˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄕㄨㄟˊ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄨㄢˊ ㄨㄢˊ ㄐㄩˋ ㄓㄥ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄑㄧˇ ㄌㄞˊ 。
turns.romanization: Háizimen wèi le shéi xiān wán wánjù zhēng le qǐlai.
turns.translation: The children started arguing over who could play with the toy first.
turns.translation_en: The children started arguing over who could play with the toy first.
turns.translation_id: Dua perusahaan bersaing untuk proyek yang sama.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 雨後花園裡出現了很多蟲子，孩子們卻覺得很有趣。
turns.hanzi: 雨後花園裡出現了很多蟲子，孩子們卻覺得很有趣。
turns.pinyin: yǔ hòu huā yuán lǐ chū xiàn le hěn duō chóng zi ， hái zi men què jué dé hěn yǒu qù 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄩˇ ㄏㄡˋ ㄏㄨㄚ ㄩㄢˊ ㄌㄧˇ ㄔㄨ ㄒㄧㄢˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄗ˙ ， ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄑㄩㄝˋ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄉㄜˊ ㄏㄣˇ ㄧㄡˇ ㄑㄩˋ 。
turns.romanization: Yǔ hòu huāyuán lǐ chūxiàn le hěn duō chóngzi, háizimen què juéde hěn yǒuqù.
turns.translation: After the rain, many insects appeared in the garden, but the children found them very interesting.
turns.translation_en: After the rain, many insects appeared in the garden, but the children found them very interesting.
turns.translation_id: Setelah hujan, banyak serangga muncul di taman, tetapi anak-anak menganggapnya sangat menarik.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 孩子們一聽到下課鈴，就像風似的跑出教室。
turns.hanzi: 孩子們一聽到下課鈴，就像風似的跑出教室。
turns.pinyin: hái zi men yī tīng dào xià kè líng ， jiù xiàng fēng shì de pǎo chū jiào shì 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄧ ㄊㄧㄥ ㄉㄠˋ ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄎㄜˋ ㄌㄧㄥˊ ， ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄈㄥ ㄕˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄆㄠˇ ㄔㄨ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄕˋ 。
turns.romanization: Háizimen yì tīngdào xiàkè líng, jiù xiàng fēng shìde pǎo chū jiàoshì.
turns.translation: As soon as the children heard the class bell, they ran out of the classroom like the wind.
turns.translation_en: As soon as the children heard the class bell, they ran out of the classroom like the wind.
turns.translation_id: Begitu anak-anak mendengar bel kelas, mereka berlari keluar kelas seperti angin.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 孩子用剪刀做手工時，老師一直在旁邊看著。
turns.hanzi: 孩子用剪刀做手工時，老師一直在旁邊看著。
turns.pinyin: hái zi yòng jiǎn dāo zuò shǒu gōng shí ， lǎo shī yì zhí zài páng biān kàn zhù 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄩㄥˋ ㄐㄧㄢˇ ㄉㄠ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄕㄡˇ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄕˊ ， ㄌㄠˇ ㄕ ㄧˋ ㄓˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄆㄤˊ ㄅㄧㄢ ㄎㄢˋ ㄓㄨˋ 。
turns.romanization: Háizi yòng jiǎndāo zuò shǒugōng shí, lǎoshī yìzhí zài pángbiān kànzhe.
turns.translation: When the children used scissors to do handicrafts, the teacher watched beside them the whole time.
turns.translation_en: When the children used scissors to do handicrafts, the teacher watched beside them the whole time.
turns.translation_id: Saat anak-anak menggunakan gunting untuk membuat kerajinan tangan, guru itu terus mengawasi mereka dari samping.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 支教老師在山區小學工作了三年，幫助很多孩子走出大山。
turns.hanzi: 支教老師在山區小學工作了三年，幫助很多孩子走出大山。
turns.pinyin: zhī jiào lǎo shī zài shān qū xiǎo xué gōng zuò le sān nián ， bāng zhù hěn duō hái zi zǒu chū dà shān 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄓ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄌㄠˇ ㄕ ㄗㄞˋ ㄕㄢ ㄑㄩ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄙㄢ ㄋㄧㄢˊ ， ㄅㄤ ㄓㄨˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄗㄡˇ ㄔㄨ ㄉㄚˋ ㄕㄢ 。
turns.romanization: Zhījiào lǎoshī zài shānqū xiǎoxué gōngzuò le sān nián, bāngzhù hěn duō háizi zǒu chū dàshān.
turns.translation: The volunteer teacher worked for three years at a primary school in the mountain area, helping many children leave the mountains.
turns.translation_en: The volunteer teacher worked for three years at a primary school in the mountain area, helping many children leave the mountains.
turns.translation_id: Guru sukarelawan tersebut bekerja selama tiga tahun di sebuah sekolah dasar di daerah pegunungan, membantu banyak anak meninggalkan pegunungan.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 孩子抬頭望著天空，想知道雲後面有什麼。
turns.hanzi: 孩子抬頭望著天空，想知道雲後面有什麼。
turns.pinyin: hái zi tái tóu wàng zhù tiān kōng ， xiǎng zhī dào yún hòu miàn yǒu shén me 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄊㄞˊ ㄊㄡˊ ㄨㄤˋ ㄓㄨˋ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄎㄨㄥ ， ㄒㄧㄤˇ ㄓ ㄉㄠˋ ㄩㄣˊ ㄏㄡˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄕㄣˊ ㄇㄜ˙ 。
turns.romanization: Háizi tái tóu wàng zhe tiānkōng, xiǎng zhīdào yún hòumian yǒu shénme.
turns.translation: The child looked up at the sky, wanting to know what was behind the clouds.
turns.translation_en: The child looked up at the sky, wanting to know what was behind the clouds.
turns.translation_id: Anak itu menengadah ke langit, ingin tahu apa yang ada di balik awan-awan itu.
